Ah, meta gaming. That age old pastime of players. To the experienced player, it is the sharing of tricks of the trade and the fear of sub optimal playing. An experienced player will also relish the value of making intentionally unreliable or intentionally against the grain choices for role play reasons. 

But to the newer player, there comes a perceived pressure when their decisions are sub optimal.  Wisdom is in being gentle enough with your opinions about how they should play, be it mechanics or social decisions. 

Personally, I often have a hard time reading social cues. And even then, lots of us have been playing together for years and ride that wave of emphatic group opinion. 
The number of neurodivergent players on the server is above half. And that is something to consider when it comes to interplay discussions about the how tos of role playing.

Meta gaming and theory crafting about the plot is some of the most gratifying things a dm can read. But its is an acquired rhythm that becomes available as your become more experienced. There are lots of kick ass players on this server. There are also lots of people who love to protect and nurture those who could use it among us. 

Remember server rule 1.
If you don't remember it, please take the time to reread it today.
